pronunciation: eks · kuh · MYOO · nih · kay · tid
definition: Had formally excluded someone from membership in a church.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: Wopsle, being knocked up, was in such a very bad temper that if the Church had been thrown open, he would probably have excommunicated the whole expedition, beginning with Joe and myself.
example_sentence: She was effectively excommunicated from the group chat.
